  let q := column v
  have he := stagger x hx p Y q H l b (Ne.symm hb)
  rw [fullTurn P H hp hi J p Y h _ hx _ l ht, fullTurn P H hp hi J p Y h _ (Points.across_in _ hx) _ l (shiftedLine x l ht),zero_add] at he; exact he.symm

proof_context.conclusion: `outer` translates the collinear configuration along `l` (`shiftedLine`, `stagger` with `K = plane b a`) and subtracts the two collinear identities, giving `LineSum p`.

lemma stagger (x : Points m) (hx : x∈conf _) (p : Parts S) (Y : SpinRows S) (q : Fin m→ S.Tag) (H : S.Hierarchy) (a b : Axis) (h : a≠b) :
    localTurn p Y (Ortho.plane b a) q (Points.across (basis a) x) = localTurn p Y (Ortho.plane b a) q x +
      ∑ i, disc (update q i (⟨_,p _ b (q i).2⟩:S.Tag)) x := by
  let K := Ortho.plane b a; let y := Points.across (basis a) x
  have he (r : Fin m→S.Tag) : disc r y=disc r x := H.translations m x hx _ (expose ∘ r)
  have hf (i : Fin m) (j : Axis) : M4.move K.val (y i) j = M4.move K.val (x i) j + basis b j := by
    have h : roll K (basis a) j=basis b j := by
      rw [show K= _ from rfl,roll_plane]; by_cases hv : j=b <;> simp [hv,Ne.symm h]
    rw [← h]; exact congr_arg (fun y : E4 => y j) (map_add (Matrix.toEuclideanLin K.val) (x i) (basis a))
  change localTurn p Y K q y=_; unfold localTurn; simp_rw [he,hf,add_smul,Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  simp [add_assoc,K]

proof_context.conclusion: `stagger` computes the angular sum at the configuration translated by `basis a`, which differs by the extra term `basis b` from the sum at the original.

def LineSum (p : Climb.Parts S) := ∀ d n (b j : Axis), j ≠ b → ∀ v : Fin n → S.Field d, ∀ x : Points n, x∈conf _ → onLine b x →
    diagram v (leaves p d j) x=0

proof_context.conclusion: `LineSum p` says `diagram v (leaves p d j) x = 0` for `x` on the line `b` and `j ≠ b`.

private lemma full_jet (h : S.Hierarchy) (W : DiffPlan S)
    (inc : W.Inclusions S) (der : W.Derivatives S)
    (p : Parts S) (c : ColorLaw p W h.spin)
    (delta : ∀ d b i u, W.deriv (d+1) b (p d i u) = p (d+1) i (W.deriv d b u))
    (hl : LineSum p)
    (b j : Axis) (hj : j ≠ b)
    {x : Points n} (hx : x ∈ conf _) (ht : onLine b x)
    (q : Fin n → S.Tag) (m : ℕ) (u : Fin m → Points n) :
    iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (row p j q) x u = 0 := by
  induction m generalizing q with
  | zero =>
    simpa using all_line h W inc p c hl b j hj q hx ht
  | succ m ih =>
    have hr : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (row p j q) x := by
      apply ContDiffAt.sum
      exact fun i _ => cont_disc h _ hx
    have hh : ContDiffAt ℝ (↑(m+1 : ℕ)) (row p j q) x :=
      hr.of_le (show ((↑(m+1 : ℕ)) : WithTop ℕ∞) ≤ ∞ from WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr le_top)
    let v := Fin.init u
    let g : Points n →L[ℝ] ℂ := (iteratedFDeriv ℝ (m+1) (row p j q) x).curryRight v
    have hb (k : Fin n) (a : Axis) : g (Points.direction k a) = 0 := by
      change iteratedFDeriv ℝ (m+1) (row p j q) x (Fin.snoc v (Points.direction k a)) = 0
      have hp :
          D (Points.direction k a) (row p j q) =ᶠ[𝓝 x] row p j (update q k (rise W a (q k))) := by
        filter_upwards [(conf_open _).mem_nhds hx] with y hy
        exact row_D h W der p delta j q hy k a
      rw [snoc_jet hh, (hp.iteratedFDeriv ℝ m).eq_of_nhds]
      exact ih _ _
    have ha (w : Points n) : g w = 0 := by
      rw [← expand_pts w, map_sum]
      simp [map_sum,hb]
    have hy := ha (u (Fin.last m))
    change iteratedFDeriv ℝ (m+1) (row p j q) x
      (Fin.snoc (Fin.init u) (u (Fin.last m))) = 0 at hy
    rwa [Fin.snoc_init_self] at hy

proof_context.conclusion: `full_jet` shows by induction on `m`, using `delta`, that every positional jet of the line sum vanishes on the line.

private lemma line_native (h : S.Hierarchy) (W : DiffPlan S) (der : W.Derivatives S) :
    LineSum W.deriv := by
  intro d n b j hj v x hx ht
  let q := column v
  let u := points fun _ : Fin n => basis j
  have hu : (∑ i : Fin n, Points.direction i j) = u := by
    simpa [u] using expand_pts u
  let F (t : ℝ) := x+t • u
  have hr : F 0 = x := by simp [F]
  have hh : HasDerivAt F u 0 := by
    have he := (ContinuousLinearMap.toSpanSingleton ℝ u).hasDerivAt (x := 0)
    simpa [F] using he.const_add x
  have he : (disc q ∘ F) = fun (_ : ℝ) => disc q x := by
    funext t
    exact h.translations n x hx (t • basis j) (fun i => ⟨(q i).1,S.representative _ (q i).2⟩)
  have hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (disc q) (F 0) := by
    rw [hr]
    exact (cont_disc h q hx).differentiableAt (by simp)
  have hz : fderiv ℝ (disc q) x u = 0 := by
    have hp := hd.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt 0 hh
    rw [he,hr] at hp
    exact hp.unique (hasDerivAt_const _ _)
  change row W.deriv j q x = 0
  rw [← hz, ← hu, map_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  exact (fromD W h der hx i j q).symm

proof_context.conclusion: `line_native` gives `LineSum W.deriv` by translation invariance, the same identities for `∂`.

  intro G L S h W inc der o p Y c hc hl
